lines.text: So, Daniel, this is the last one. How's the wrist?
Since last time I'm back climbing twice a week with no pain at all.
Grip's equal on both sides now, and your wrist bends back just as far as the good one.
Keep taping the wrist for the hard overhangs until the end of next month, then wean off it.
If it starts clicking or swelling after a session, give me a ring and we'll get you back in.
Cheers, Ana. Thanks for sorting me out.
My pleasure. Off you go, climb safe.
Oh, Mrs Patel! How was the cruise?
Lovely, thank you, though I've come back with a terrible pain in my left knee.
Oh no. Come through and tell me all about it.
